meta.name: free-tools
meta.description: When the user wants to plan, evaluate, or build a free tool for marketing purposes — lead generation, SEO value, or brand awareness. Also use when the user mentions "engineering as marketing," "free tool," "marketing tool," "calculator," "generator," "interactive tool," "lead gen tool," "build a tool for leads," "free resource," "ROI calculator," "grader tool," "audit tool," "should I build a free tool," or "tools for lead gen." Use this whenever someone wants to build something useful and give it away to attract leads or earn links. For downloadable content lead magnets (ebooks, checklists, templates), see lead-magnets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并落地免费工具，用引流资产换取线索和链接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你想用免费工具做营销获客，但不确定该做什么或怎么做
copy.tagline_en: Build free tools that attract leads and earn links
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to use a free tool to generate marketing leads and grow your brand.

howto.what: Claude 会成为“工程化营销”策略顾问,帮你规划、评估免费工具:先询问业务背景、目标与资源,再给出工具类型、获客方式、SEO、自建/低代码/嵌入、MVP 范围和评分表等建议。
howto.when: 当你想为营销目的规划、评估或搭建免费工具(获客、SEO、品牌),或提到“工程化营销”“免费工具”“计算器”等关键词时触发;下载类内容(电子书、清单等)另用 lead-magnets。

say.text: 我想做一个免费工具吸引潜在客户,帮我评估可行性。
say.note: 会先检查产品营销背景文件,再追问目标和资源。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 ROI 计算器,用来收集销售线索。
say.note: 会建议何时要求留邮箱、SEO 关键词与 MVP 范围。

say.text: 我有个免费工具的点子,帮我判断值不值得做。
say.note: 会用评分表逐项打分,给出值不值得做的结论。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an engineering-as-marketing strategy advisor. It gathers business context, goals, and resources, then suggests tool types, lead capture, SEO, build vs. no-code, MVP scope, and an evaluation scorecard.
howto.when_en: Use when the user plans, evaluates, or builds a free tool for marketing (leads, SEO, brand), or mentions "free tool," "calculator," "generator," etc. Downloadable lead magnets: see lead-magnets.

say_en.text: I want to build a free tool to attract leads. Help me assess the idea.
say_en.note: It checks product-marketing context first, then asks about goals and resources.

say_en.text: Help me design an ROI calculator to capture leads.
say_en.note: It suggests when to gate, SEO keywords, and MVP scope.

say_en.text: I have a free-tool idea. Is it worth building?
say_en.note: It scores each factor and recommends whether to proceed.
